data_fields.name: yaw_catchup_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.25 s, factor 4*dt below, dt at or above

best_idea: Drive the walk-cycle phase from distance covered and the strafe pose from the angle between facing and travel (playing the cycle backwards past 120 degrees), then cross-fade the previous clip's frozen last pose out over 0.2 s.
decision_why: The facing-versus-travel blend and the distance-driven cycle fit a fast duel footwork set (row 6), but the donor's time-based fallback, frame-time catch-up and model-format frame units do not; Frankendom takes the shape on a fixed tick with its own clip data.
acceptance: A player running sideways sees the sideways step pose, running backwards plays the step cycle in reverse, and switching from a swing to idle fades the swing's last pose out over 0.2 s; a client test asserts blend byte 0 at +90 degrees facing offset and 255 at -90, and the cross-fade weight 1 at the switch and 0 at 0.2 s.
